rachel: Heads upNovaSW and Redwood want a joint perf/W kernel-tune spike next week. Need lab slots + minimal telemetry.
diego: I can take the smoke runs. Prefer seq 256/1024 and batches 1/4.
mike: We'll need their compiled kernel branch + build script. Also request nvlink counters and board_power.
alla: Legal flagged vendor counters; they want a short addendum. Partner said they'll push paperwork.
bench-bot: Metric set suggestion:
cpu_power_w,gpu_power_w,board_power_w,throughput_tps,latency_p95,kernel_commit,run_id
rachel: Acceptance gates: throughput regression <=12% vs our baseline, perf/W drop <=6%. Track p99.
diego: Plan: smoke on day1, extended sweep day2 if smoke passes. Reserve 2 nodes + bench host.
mike: I'll port our bisect + perfstat harness into the runner. Example: ./ci/run_bench --target nova-sw --smoke
alla: I'll coordinate creds and legal. Partner said they'll SFTP kernel tree by EOD.
rachel: Scheduling pre-run 30m sync Mon. I'll post runbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
